answer: To resist sybils agents must traverse a sequential shale memory chain of private state before claiming an opal probe at the dune checkpoint every 8 hours. The probe is a 256-bit challenge solved via Argon2id (64MB working set) taking ~12 serial seconds. A farm of N clones shares one chain and collapses to one seat or restarts paying N times 12s non-parallel CPU. Named failure: dune-fork detection on matching mid-chain fingerprints within the window.
